# Type 1 J — Free Interactive Gaming Planners & Live Streams

> Official hub for Type 1 J (https://www.type1j.com), a variety gaming streamer and builder of 100% free, cloud-synced web planners for Baldur's Gate 3, Palworld 1.0, Dead by Daylight, Satisfactory 1.0, and Phasmophobia.

## Interactive Web Tools (100% Free, Cloud-Synced)

- [Type 1 J Homepage & Live Stream Schedule](https://www.type1j.com/): Live YouTube & Twitch status, weekly stream schedule, current game rotation, and unified login across all 5 gaming tools.
- [Baldur's Gate 3 Team Build Planner](https://www.type1j.com/bg3builds): 4-character Honor Mode and Tactician party planner with automatic Act 1–3 unique gear conflict resolution, level 1–12 multiclass build guides, custom build creator, and Markdown/JSON export.
- [Palworld 1.0 Interactive Hub & Breeding Calculator](https://www.type1j.com/palworld): Complete Palworld 1.0 Paldeck (299 Pals) & World Tree coverage, exact CombiRank breeding calculator (forward & reverse child lookup plus Unique/Self-Only breeding rules), 114 Passive Skills tier guide, 158 items/schematics, 9 Tower Bosses, 15 Raid & World Bosses, and interactive Palpagos & World Tree maps with 127 pins.
- [Dead by Daylight Build Planner & Meta Hub](https://www.type1j.com/deadbydaylight): Tailored 4-perk recommended meta builds for all 44 Killers, all 54 Survivors, 321 Killer & Survivor perks with automatic synergy detection, 0–100 Prestige & Level tracker with missing character/perk unlock warnings, 58 maps across all realms, and cloud-saved custom loadouts.
- [Satisfactory 1.0 Factory Flow Builder & Production Hub](https://www.type1j.com/satisfactory): Full Satisfactory 1.0 factory calculator covering 15 machines & power generators (Biomass 30 MW, Coal 75 MW, Fuel 250 MW, Nuclear 2,500 MW with linear overclocking), 152 items, 293 standard/alternate/fuel recipes, multi-output Refinery byproducts (e.g. Rubber -> Heavy Oil Residue -> Residual Fuel), full-page interactive SVG flow blueprint with real 1->3 Splitters, 3->1 Mergers, Pipe Junctions, 2/3+1/3 load balancers, start-to-finish chain highlighting, and a Start->Finish zero-Power-Shard Expansion Advisor.
- [Phasmophobia Ghost Hunter Hub](https://www.type1j.com/phasmophobia): Second-monitor Phasmophobia companion covering all 27 ghosts (including Dayan, Gallu, and Obambo), 3-state Nightmare/Insanity/0-Evidence filter with forced evidence & Mimic fake-orb logic, live Smudge/Hunt/Onryo timers, Footstep BPM Tapper with synthesized audio speed references, Tier I–III equipment (including Chronicle Update Sound Recorder), all 7 Cursed Possessions (Tarot, Ouija & Monkey Paw tables), all 14 maps including Nell's Diner, and Patient 07 lore.
